inputs.current_address: fresh current-state address; requires Git causal head and may carry prompt/frontier/contract/issue coordinates
inputs.execution_surface: actually exposed current operations; feature/issue/CI claims do not count
inputs.assessments: exactly one evidence-bearing assessment for every one of the 10 historical actions

assessment_rules.SATISFIED: requires evidence_refs showing the current state already closes the historical intent
assessment_rules.SUPERSEDED: requires evidence_refs + reason identifying the newer lawful/current replacement
assessment_rules.DEFERRED: requires reason; remains accounted-for curriculum but is not executed now
assessment_rules.RESIDUAL: requires evidence_refs + current task; may declare required capability/operation and routing metrics
assessment_rules.HOLD: requires evidence_refs + reason identifying the blocker

candidate_projection.shape: compatible with RehydrationCampaignRuntime candidate fields: candidate_id/task/metrics/source
candidate_projection.required_operation_rule: if required_operation is absent from the supplied current execution surface, emit typed HOLD instead of candidate
candidate_projection.requires_execution_authority_rule: a residual declaring execution authority must bind an exact operation

status_lattice.HOLD: valid input but one or more typed current blockers remain
status_lattice.RESIDUAL_CANDIDATES: one or more current lawful routing candidates exist; pulse cannot advance yet
status_lattice.ACCOUNTED: all ten historical actions are satisfied/superseded/deferred with no holds/residual candidates

advance_law.RESIDUAL_or_HOLD: do not advance pulse until current result/hold is metabolized

non_goals: turn issue/ledger text into SCHED READY
